verification.acceptance_test: AT1 cancellation: real gated operation remains busy after request with no confirmation; poll timeout cannot imply stopped. Correlated cooperative confirmation alone yields cancelled with cancellation_confirmed:true and terminal result, followed by successful fresh-ID work. Withhold/mismatch/forge acknowledgement in private fault peer: unknown/cancel_requested retains busy, no false result; terminal completion race remains completed. Validate records/C12 and clean reopen after confirmed cancellation; retain crash-disagreement refusal.

AT2 source-bound handoff: validate emitted handoff/reattach records against schemas/C12 and verify actual owner/generation/lease/pending/source/command/resource bindings. Valid committed manifest succeeds; changed workspace bytes/revision, missing/uncommitted command, escaping/duplicate paths, altered stored provenance and wrong identities refuse without execution or overwritten outcomes. A lifecycle payload/command that would mutate the image is never executed during reattach. Test actual fourteen-command harness scheduling and targeted failure propagation while preserving original F105 checks.

AT3 case5: admit gate, timed poll reaches deadline with stopped_waiting and live original child/running lane; both immediate and finite waits bounded. A fresh-ID conflicting submit is rejected busy with no receipt; duplicate ID retains conflict precedence. Release gate normally, observe completed_wait/result, then fresh work succeeds. Kill a waiting client and verify no cancellation or duplicate dispatch; keep semantic success control.

AT4 case6: exit original client while gate remains pending, invoke reattach from a fresh client using durable snapshot and valid source. Require same live child/generation/owner/lease/outstanding, no execute frame or counter mutation; stale generation/lease, foreign owner, wrong pending ref or changed attempt refuses. Resolve original operation then valid new work succeeds. Missing endpoint/durable disagreement refuses rather than auto-restarting or clearing busy.

AT5 case10: generate committed source/fixtures and ordered replay request templates in a private repository, obtain source-bound handoff, then recreate result using only those pinned inputs in a fresh worktree/session via normal submit/poll. Old child memory or warm-only mutations cannot supply expected output. Include a negative missing/changed source or command and positive replay control; distinct process/generation, declared resources and unchanged governed attempt must be observed. This is stub reproduction proof, not phase020 acceptance delivery.

interface.compatibility: Keep python3 tools/runtime_session.py ACTION --root ABSOLUTE_STATE_ROOT --request FILE, newline JSON socket wrapper {action,request}, bounded frames/logs and current paths. Add usable cancel-operation and reattach-session; accept remains unsupported. Keep existing requests valid. Only submit-operation may execute project code. No new public action.
interface.identity: Retain strict types, closed objects, duplicate-key rejection and owner/role/generation/lease checks. cancel and reattach additionally carry contract_id, step_key, attempt and pass the existing read-only counter guard. They require the current human or Generator owner; Orchestrator lifecycle authority alone does not grant them. Poll retains its existing owner/Orchestrator policy. Public trial requests fail before endpoint contact; direct controller trial requests are refused. Failed control requests return error receipts without overwriting the target operation. Existing rejected submits remain supervisor-written executed:false records; duplicate-ID conflict still precedes busy.
interface.poll_request: poll-operation adds optional limits:{timeout_seconds:NUMBER}. Only that key is allowed here; finite nonboolean 0<=timeout_seconds<=30. Absent limits retains immediate snapshot behavior. Explicit zero is a timed poll with an immediate deadline. Submit limits retain their recorded operation metadata role; submit returns admission immediately and does not implicitly wait or cancel.
interface.wait: Use a monotonic deadline. A timed poll observes the correlated operation until terminal or deadline while the supervisor continues servicing child/control traffic. Terminal observation records completed_wait; expiry with running/cancel_requested/unknown records stopped_waiting without changing status, execution, generation, outstanding pointer or result-file absence. No wait creates a second execution or releases the lane. A later terminal observation replaces stopped_waiting with completed_wait so existing C12 remains valid. Client disconnect never cancels admitted work. Waiting transport is bounded by the requested deadline plus existing control grace; other control calls remain bounded.
interface.cancel_request: cancel-operation requires existing common session/requester/expected_generation/expected_lease_epoch plus operation_id and contract_id/step_key/attempt, no payload. Unknown ID returns unknown_operation. For the current running operation, durably publish cancel_requested and cancellation_confirmed:false before one cancel frame. Return that nonterminal snapshot without waiting for acknowledgement. Repeated cancel while pending sends no duplicate frame. A terminal operation returns its unchanged observed record; cancellation cannot relabel completed work.
interface.cancel_protocol: Controller sends {type:cancel,session_id,operation_id,generation,lease_epoch} for the outstanding operation. Stub gate checks this control input while waiting and stops that gate before replying with a result frame carrying type:result, session_id, operation_id, generation, lease_epoch, status:cancelled, result:null, image_consistent:true, cancellation_confirmed:true. Existing completed frames remain unchanged. The supervisor accepts cancellation only for matching pending cancel identity and confirmed stop; absent, malformed, wrong-ID/generation/lease or unsolicited confirmation cannot free the lane or fabricate cancelled. Publish the accepted result frame, terminal operation with confirmation, then clear the pointer. Terminal completion winning the race stays completed. Child death is not cancellation confirmation; uncertainty stays unknown/busy and close uses observed terminated semantics.
interface.cancel_consistency: The deterministic gate has no mutation before release, so its cooperative acknowledgement may report image_consistent:true; this does not assert rollback or source/heap equality. No arbitrary project interruption, threads or signal-as-cancelled shortcut. Extend durable reconciliation to validate cancelled result/confirmation pairs; preserve crash-disagreement fail-closed behavior across running/result/terminal/pointer publications and generation replacement.
interface.reattach_request: reattach-session requires common identity, contract_id/step_key/attempt, expected_outstanding_operation_ref (null or exact nonempty string from durable session), and handoff as defined below. The caller reads durable session/operation records first. Under the existing supervisor lock, compare actual live identities, metadata, session and correlated pending record before success. Wrong owner/role, stale generation/lease, attempt mismatch, wrong pending reference or source mismatch refuses without transfer, execute frame or replacement generation. A real completion racing the caller snapshot requires reread/retry, not a fabricated continuation. No live endpoint or ambiguous records fails closed; callers reconstruct separately from committed source using normal open and submit permissions.
interface.handoff_input: handoff is a closed object: workspace_path absolute existing Git worktree directory; source_revision lowercase40hex; source_manifest nonempty array of closed {path,sha256} entries; command_refs nonempty array of strings; external_resources array (may be empty) of existing schema resource objects. source_state is derived committed, never a caller assertion. Paths are unique repository-relative regular files, no absolute/parent traversal/symlink escape. sha256 is lowercase64hex. Every command_ref names a manifest entry containing a committed UTF-8 JSON replay template with exactly kind,payload,context,limits in the existing submit data shape. No shell interpretation.
interface.source_checks: Verify Git HEAD equals source_revision, each declared file exists in that commit and workspace and both byte hashes equal its manifest hash, all command refs resolve and parse as replay templates, and resource objects conform to existing schema. Reject missing, dirty, mismatched, duplicate or escaping inputs before successful reentry. No claim about undeclared files or heap equality. Bind the first validated provenance in supervisor metadata; later reattach to that incarnation must match it, apart from workspace_path relocation with identical committed content. A changed provenance requires a separately opened session; never silently bless changed source for the warm image.
interface.handoff_records: On successful reattach atomically write ROOT/session_id/handoff.json as an existing runtime_session schema record with transition:handoff, current owner/lease/generation/outstanding ref, committed source fields, command refs and resource refs. Write runtime_session.json with transition:reattach and previous_owner/previous_generation/previous_lease_epoch/previous_outstanding_operation_ref equal to that same checked current snapshot. Return the latter record; source provenance fields are retained. Subsequent state changes must remove or refresh transition-only previous fields so C12 equality never becomes stale. These files are diagnostic snapshots, never client-written operation results. Multi-file publication disagreement must fail closed before further execution; no overwrite of unresolved operation/result evidence.
interface.replay: The handoff consumer preserves/commits the snapshot by ordinary evidence handling, obtains its pinned source in a fresh private worktree and opens a separate development session with the same governed contract/step/attempt (Root state unchanged). It reads each committed template in command_refs order, supplies fresh session/operation IDs and actual generation/lease/requester, and invokes normal submit then poll. The controller never auto-runs command_refs during open/reattach/transfer/close. Reproduction is independently demonstrated by case10; creation of provenance is not proof of replay. The fresh session has distinct child/generation identity; unreplayable warm-only mutations must not supply the reproduced result. External resources remain declared and require isolated/reset test setup; no resource orchestrator is added.
interface.responses: Keep stdout/socket {ok:true,result:RECORD} or {ok:false,error:REASON,result?:RECORD}. Exit0 means an observed snapshot or admitted request, not terminal execution success: running/cancel_requested with stopped_waiting may return0. Unknown/infrastructure ambiguity returns70 with the available unknown record, never successful completion. Policy/identity/conflict/busy/source_mismatch/continuity_mismatch refusal returns1; malformed request/template/types return64; missing endpoint, corrupt durable records and infrastructure uncertainty return70. Timeouts never emit cancelled/terminated. Unknown options/actions remain nonzero.
interface.observability: Retain 126 controller.json PID/group/token fields, fd3 child protocol, JSON received_operation_id stdout receipts and result-file names. Cancellation diagnostics may add received_cancel_operation_id JSON lines, never execute receipts. Tests observe real PID continuity, pending record/pointer, child receipts and absence/preservation of result bytes. No test-only public fault or recovery switch.
